answer:
ГИПОТЕЗА (data-grounded, ответ на вопрос «What changes occurred in the wealth inequality for white males and females between 1990 and 1996?»)

Between 1990 and 1996, wealth among white NLSY79 respondents grew strongly in the upper part of the distribution but its picture at the bottom is ambiguous because the share of exactly-zero wealth among whites doubled (22.9% → 42.9%; stable for black/Hispanic groups), suggesting 1996 zeros largely encode missing asset data rather than true zero wealth. Under the base scenario (zeros = true zero wealth), the median wealth of both white males (15 601 → 8 900) and white females (20 100 → 8 825) collapsed and the modest female advantage of 1990 (+4 499, bootstrap 95% CI [1 100, 7 600]) disappeared by 1996 (−75, CI [−4 800, 4 303]) — i.e., a convergence to parity driven by the bottom of the distribution. Under the sensitivity scenario (zeros = missing, excluded) and on the consistent panel (non-zero in both waves), the opposite bottom-half picture emerges: median wealth roughly tripled for both sexes (men 42 000 → 124 063; women 49 088 → 127 220) and inequality fell (Gini: men 0.715 → 0.639, women 0.714 → 0.616; p90/p10 fell from ~132/265 to ~70/92), while the female–male median gap narrowed from +7 088 (CI barely including 0) / +9 716 on the panel (CI [399, 17 500]) to +3 158 (CI spanning zero) — i.e., the gender gap in median wealth among whites narrowed to statistical insignificance, and women's winsorized mean advantage (+4 313) even reversed to a male mean advantage (−8 343). Hypothesis: between 1990 and 1996 white men and white women experienced comparable, strong wealth growth in the measurable (non-zero) range with declining inequality, and the female–male wealth gap among whites narrowed from a small but significant female median advantage to a statistically insignificant difference; whether the lowest quartile genuinely lost ground or simply dropped out of measurement cannot be resolved with these data, and any real "impoverishment of the bottom" claim should be withheld.

WORKFLOW (executed)
1. Loaded data/nls_incarceration_processed.csv (12 013 × 6, no NaNs; noted typo 'hipanic' in race — does not affect white-only analysis). Filtered race == white (7 099 obs: 3 630 female, 3 469 male).
2. Three scenarios, all with negatives retained: A base (0 = true zero), B sensitivity (0 = missing, excluded per wave), C consistent panel (non-zero in both waves; gap-change compared on identical samples within each scenario, per your instruction).
3. Per group×year: n, mean, winsorized mean (1%/99%), median (bootstrap 95% CI, B=2000, seed 202601), p10/p25/p75/p90, IQR, p90/p10, Gini (mean-absolute-difference formula, valid with negatives), shares of negative and zero values.
4. Gender gap (female − male) per year per scenario with bootstrap CI for the median gap.
5. ever_jailed: descriptive slice only (n = 57 jailed men, 12 jailed women — underpowered, confounded, not part of the main answer).
6. Outputs: artifacts/analysis.py (executed), artifacts/results_scenario_A/B/C.csv, artifacts/results.pkl.

KEY EVIDENCE (from the run)
- Scenario A: medians male 15 601→8 900, female 20 100→8 825; winsorized means rise (male 81 587→126 019; female 88 479→123 901); Gini ~0.78–0.80 both years/sexes; zero share male 25.7%→43.3%, female 20.3%→42.6%; median gap 1990 +4 499 CI [1 100; 7 600] → 1996 −75 CI [−4 800; 4 303].
- Scenario B: medians male 42 000→124 063, female 49 088→127 220; Gini male 0.715→0.639, female 0.714→0.616; p90/p10 male 131.6→70.1, female 264.6→91.9; median gap +7 088 (CI [−701; 14 951]) → +3 158 (CI [−8 701; 14 805]); mean gap +4 313 → −8 343.
- Scenario C (n=1 851 male, 1 979 female panel): medians 48 100→127 010 (male), 57 816→131 000 (female); Gini 0.703→0.633 / 0.702→0.610; gap +9 716 CI [399; 17 500] → +3 990 CI [−8 700; 16 000].
- ever_jailed slice: jailed respondents have far lower wealth (median 0–1 400 vs ~16–20 k for non-jailed in 1990) but n = 12/57 — descriptive only.

SCENARIO DIVERGENCE (honestly stated, per your instruction): вывод о «падении медианного богатства» существует ТОЛЬКО в сценарии A и полностью объясняется удвоением доли нулей в 1996 у белых (диагностический признак missing-кодировки: у black/Hispanic доля нулей стабильна, при белых 22.9%→42.9%). В сценариях B/C богатство растёт и неравенство снижается. Согласованное между сценариями ядро вывода: (i) верхняя часть распределения богатства у белых обоих полов заметно выросла; (ii) гендерный разрыв медиан внутри белых сократился и в 1996 статистически незначим; (iii) при исключении нулей Gini и p90/p10 снижаются у обоих полов. Всё, что касается нижнего хвоста в 1996, — неустойчиво и в гипотезе помечено как неразрешимое на этих данных.

LIMITATIONS / UNCERTAINTIES
- Нет ID → парный рост и прямой panel attrition не идентифицируемы; сценарий C — косвенная панель (потенциальная select-смещённость: выжившие богаче).
- Сопоставимость composite-переменных между волнами принимается по описанию датасета, проверить нечем.
- Gini при отрицательных значениях трактовать осторожно (основной вывод о динамике дублируется p90/p10 и IQR).
- Winsorized mean устойчив к хвостам, но не к систематическому missing-кодированию нулей.
- ever_jailed-срез: мощность (12/57) и confounding (jailed коррелирует с полом) — только иллюстрация.
